title: Assembly Line Parts Staging & Storage Bins
description: Foundational workplace English module covering assembly line parts staging & storage bins.
learning_objectives: Master professional Prepositions of Direction (into, onto, across) in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in assembly line parts staging & storage bins
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: The mechanic placed the torque wrench socket _____ the central backbone tube.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'under' accurately describes the physical spatial relationship here.
explanations.wrong_C: Preposition 'inside' does not fit the mechanical mounting geometry.
explanations.wrong_D: Preposition 'next to' indicates incorrect direction or orientation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spatial prepositions require exact physical matching. Czech 'pod rourou' = 'under the tube', 'mezi polonápravami' = 'between the half-axles'.
